Show.Description: Displays an Action Group on screen

AddItem.Description: Adds an item (code/description pair) to a control's item collection
Constraints: Call Clear first when fully reloading the collection from scratch

Arguments.Index: (Optional) 1-based insertion position; append at end if omitted

Clear.Description: Empties a control's item collection or clears drawn shapes from a map

Arguments.GeographyId: (Optional, maps only) ID of the shape to clear; clears all shapes if omitted

Reload.Description: Re-reads the underlying table and refreshes a dynamic control's item list at runtime
Constraints: Applies only at execution time; use when source data changed and the list needs refreshing without navigating away

RemoveItem.Description: Removes an item from a collection of controls

Arguments.Code: Code value of the item to remove

Repaint.Description: Repaints a control to reflect runtime property changes
Constraints: Required after setting runtime properties (color, font, size, etc.) to make changes visually effective

Value.Description: Returns the code of the item at a given position in a control's collection

Arguments.Index: 1-based position of the item to retrieve

FirstPage.Description: Navigates a paginated grid to its first page
Constraints: Only effective when automatic paging is enabled (grid Rows property ≠ 0)

PreviousPage.Description: Navigates a paginated grid to its previous page
Constraints: Only effective when automatic paging is enabled (grid Rows property ≠ 0)

NextPage.Description: Navigates a paginated grid to its next page
Constraints: Only effective when automatic paging is enabled (grid Rows property ≠ 0)

LastPage.Description: Navigates a paginated grid to its last page
Constraints: Only effective when automatic paging is enabled (grid Rows property ≠ 0)

Load.Description: Loads the current row into a grid during its Load event
Constraints: Must be used only from owner grid `Load` event
Required with multiple grids to identify row ownership
Required in base-table-less grids; otherwise no rows are loaded

Refresh.Description: Reloads a grid by triggering its Refresh event followed by its Load event
Constraints: Refreshes only the target grid, not the entire form
Useful when multiple grids coexist on the same panel

Select.Description: Selects a grid row by its position

SetLayerVisible.Description: Shows or hides a map layer by its identifier

Arguments.Visible: Boolean; true to show, false to hide

ScrollIntoView.Description: Scrolls the form to bring a control into view at a specified position

Arguments.Y: Vertical offset; based on GeneXus.VerticalPosition enum domain
Arguments.X: (Optional) Horizontal offset; based on GeneXus.HorizontalPosition enum domain

JSEvent.Description: Binds JavaScript code to a control's click or change event
Constraints: JavaScript must return `true` to trigger the GeneXus event or `false` to suppress it

JsEventName: Use 'onclick' for input, button, image, and TextBlock
Use 'onchange' for comboBox, dynamicComboBox, listBox, and dynamicListBox
Arguments.JsCodeString: JavaScript expression to evaluate on the event

PrintForm.Description: Prints the current form layout to the default printer

SetFocus.Description: Moves input focus to the control

SetAnimation.Description: Loads a Lottie animation from a Theme or DSO class

SetProgress.Description: Sets the current animation progress position
